title: constitution guard --format json output
description: The machine payload `constitution guard --format json` writes to stdout (implementation-plan.md §2.7). It is the only thing on stdout in JSON mode: a violations array plus a summary roll-up. Warnings and human text go to stderr.

violations.description: Every detected illegal mutation, sorted deterministically. Empty (never null) on a clean result.

kind.description: The exact violation type (implementation-plan.md §2.7 enum). There is no catch-all.

id.description: The ADR id the violation cites (e.g. ADR-0007). Falls back to the bare filename only when a deleted file's id cannot be parsed.

file.description: The repo-root-relative, forward-slash path of the file in violation (e.g. constitution/adr/ADR-0007-x.md).

oldFile.description: Set only for kind=file_renamed: the base-ref path the file was renamed from.

files.description: Set only for kind=id_collision: every file sharing the colliding id (>= 2 entries).

field.description: Set only for kind=frozen_field_changed: the frontmatter field that changed (e.g. title, category, status).

message.description: A human-readable, single-line explanation of the violation.

checked.description: Number of ADRs scanned on disk.

clean.description: True iff violations is empty; the exit code is 0 when true, 1 when false.
